sources.title: Effectiveness of interventions for improving educational outcomes for people with disabilities in low‐ and middle‐income countries: A systematic review
sources.why: Most recent Campbell systematic review directly answering what works for disability education in LMICs; 28 studies included.

sources.title: Implementation of Inclusive Education: A Systematic Review of Studies of Inclusive Education Interventions in Low- and Lower-Middle-Income Countries
sources.container: International Journal of Disability, Development and Education
sources.why: First systematic review of IE interventions in low/lower-middle-income countries; 31 studies across 19 countries.

sources.title: Evidence and gap map of studies assessing the effectiveness of interventions for people with disabilities in low‐and middle‐income countries
sources.why: Campbell EGM mapping all disability intervention evidence in LMICs; 40 education studies identified.

sources.title: Inclusive Education and Children with Disabilities: Quality Education for All in Low and Middle Income Countries
sources.why: Systematic literature review of education strategies for children with disabilities in LMICs; 131 articles analysed.

sources.title: Intersectional Barriers to and Facilitators of Educational Inclusion for Persons With Disabilities in Low‐ and Middle‐Income Countries: A Systematic Literature Review
sources.why: Most recent systematic review examining structural, environmental, and psychosocial barriers and facilitators to educational inclusion in LMICs.

sources.title: Barriers to, and facilitators of, education for children with disabilities worldwide: a descriptive review
sources.why: Descriptive review of barriers and facilitators to education for children with disabilities globally, including LMIC-specific findings.

sources.title: Policy Guidelines on Inclusion in Education
sources.why: Key UNESCO policy guideline on inclusive education, covering cost-effective measures for countries with scarce resources.

sources.title: A Guide for Ensuring Inclusion and Equity in Education
sources.why: UNESCO operational guide for governments on implementing inclusive education policies, with LMIC examples including Cambodia and Ethiopia.
